en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 159 - It is narrated from Husain bin Saeed from Hammad bin Isa from Rabai bin Abdullah from Fudail bin Yasar that he said:

Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s) said: When Imam Husain (a.s) moved to Iraq, he entrusted his will, books and other matters to Umme Salma, wife of the Holy Prophet (s) and told her: That which I have given to you, when my elder son comes to you, you must hand them over to him. When Husain (a.s) was martyred, Ali bin Husain, Imam Zainul Abideen (a.s) came to Umme Salma and she handed over to him all that Imam Husain (a.s) had deposited with her.
